title: Pressure Scenario Manifest
description: Contract for a Phase-33 skill-behavior pressure-scenario manifest. The runner (scripts/lib/skill-behavior/runner.cjs) loads manifests conforming to this schema, spawns a subagent against `setup_prompt` under the named `pressures`, and validates the response against the `expected_compliance` / `expected_violations` regex sources (compiled with new RegExp(source)). The 5-value `pressures` enum and the required-field set come verbatim from ROADMAP Phase-33 SC#2.

pressures.description: One or more pressure vectors applied in the setup_prompt.

setup_prompt.description: The prompt handed to the subagent — embeds the pressure(s) and asks it to act.

expected_compliance.description: Regex SOURCE strings the response MUST match to count as compliant (the runner compiles each with new RegExp(source)).

expected_violations.description: Regex SOURCE strings that, if matched, count as a violation (the runner compiles each with new RegExp(source)). May be empty.

description.description: Optional free-text scenario note (33-03 baselines reference it).

variant.description: Optional A/B variant label, e.g. "trigger-only" | "what-clause" (33-04 description-format A/B).

variants.description: Optional array of A/B variant descriptors for a single-manifest A/B pair (33-04). Each item is an object, e.g. { label, description }.

body_probe.description: Optional body-only probe prompt the A/B scenario asks (33-04 description-format A/B).
